findings.evidence: Line 400 `noncomputable abbrev gammaS`; line 85 `public section` with no `@[expose]`; PR description: "Because it is reducible, `simp` evaluates its entries with the existing `singletGluonMatrix_*` simp lemmas, so no parallel entry lemmas are needed."
findings.fix: Make it `noncomputable def gammaS` and supply the characteristic API: `gammaS_def` plus `@[simp]` entry lemmas `gammaS_zero_zero = gammaQQ c N`, `gammaS_zero_one = gammaQGSinglet c N`, `gammaS_one_zero = gammaGQ c N`, `gammaS_one_one = gammaGG c N`.
findings.issue: `gammaS` is a reducible `abbrev`, which exposes its body (the only exposed body in a file using `public section` without `@[expose]`) purely so that the upstream `singletGluonMatrix_*` simp lemmas unfold it; the docstring says this is why "no parallel entry lemmas are needed".

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'singletGluonMatrix_zero_one' SingletDecomposition.lean:460-462` shows `@[simp]`; AnomalousDimension.lean:404-406 has `gammaS_zero_one` with no attribute.
findings.fix: With `gammaS` a non-reducible `def`, mark the four entry lemmas `@[simp]` with `gammaS_zero_one` stating `gammaQGSinglet c N`, so the singlet entry has one normal form; add the parallel `analyticAt_gammaQGSinglet_one` for the entry that actually sits in `γ^S`.
findings.issue: `gammaS_zero_one` is not `@[simp]` while `singletGluonMatrix_zero_one` is (`SingletDecomposition.lean:461`), so through the reducible `gammaS` simp normalises the quark-from-gluon entry to `2 * c.nF * gammaQG c N`, a form none of `gammaQGSinglet_apply`, `meromorphic_gammaQGSinglet`, `analyticAt_gammaQGSinglet`, `gammaQGSinglet_ofReal_eq_moment` match. The `gammaQGSinglet` API is unreachable from the matrix.

findings.evidence: AnomalousDimension.lean:224-228; Continuation.lean:111-112 `private theorem add_one_ne_neg_natCast`; `analyticAt_complexHarmonic` (Continuation.lean:155) takes exactly this hypothesis.
findings.fix: Make both public in their canonical home next to the hypothesis shape they serve (`Mathematics/HarmonicSum/Continuation.lean`, which already carries the same pattern privately as `add_one_ne_neg_natCast`, or the Digamma `Extensions` module), and use them from here.
findings.issue: `add_natCast_ne_zero` (line 224) and `one_ne_neg_natCast` (line 227) are `private` but state only facts about `ℂ` and `ℕ` casts with proofs independent of this file's subject; they are the side-condition glue for `analyticAt_complexHarmonic`, `analyticAt_gammaQQ` and `analyticAt_gammaGG`. Since only the `N = 1` specialisations are exported, a consumer applying these at any other point (e.g. on the Mellin inversion contour this file motivates) must re-prove `∀ m : ℕ, N ≠ -m` by hand.

summary: The headline definition `gammaS` is an `abbrev`, i.e. a body exposed deliberately in place of entry lemmas, in a file that otherwise hides bodies; this also leaves the quark-from-gluon entry with a simp normal form that bypasses the `gammaQGSinglet` API. Two general cast helpers are hidden as `private`, so the analyticity lemmas are unusable away from `N = 1` without re-proving their side conditions.
